instruction: Candid black and white medium full shot of a couple hugging on a paved walkway. On the right, the man in the long dark coat (R1) is seen from behind, embracing his partner. On the left, the woman in the black cap and scarf (R2) smiles warmly, her arms wrapped around his back under soft daylight.
